description: Get a random tongue twister from a built-in collection of 40 classics — tap for a new one and try saying it three times fast.

faqs.a: 40 classic tongue twisters, from 'She sells seashells' to 'Peter Piper'.
faqs.q: How many tongue twisters are included?

faqs.a: Yes — a built-in difficulty tag (Easy, Medium, Hard) is shown with each twister.
A “Say it 3× fast” challenge mode with a timer is built in — try to finish before time runs out.
Yes — copy any twister to share it.

howto: Tap “New twister” for a random one.
Read it aloud three times fast.
Try Challenge mode against the timer.
title: Tongue Twister Generator
